text.tspan: Monthly confirmed cases of influenza B
This includes confirmed cases of any lineage of influenza B virus. Only a fraction of potential cases of influenza
are tested by labs to confirm whether they have influenza and to identify their lineage. The level of testing may
vary between countries and over time.
